ARREST OF C.D.S.219 BY OTHER AUTHORITIES.
==========================================
Further to report dated July 14, 1940 with a view
to making some enquiries concerning the missing C.D.S.
on the morning of July 14, 1940 Detective Inspector
Tabrum and Inspector Yamaguchi visited the Chungsan
Road Court and ascertained from an official notice
posted at the entrance thereto that it had recently
removed to Nantao.
Enquiries to locate the C.D.S. will be continued.

A. I. Tabrum
Det. Inspector

ARREST OF C.D.S.219 BY OTHER AUTHORITIES.
==========================================

I beg to report having received information from
a fairly reliable source to the effect that C.D.S.219
was arrested by members of the Special Service Corps,
12 Sing Nyi Tsung (信義邨), on a charge of making
false allegations against Captain Ting Chien Kweng
(丁昆建).

The informant states that C.D.S.219 is now being
held at the Chungsan Road Court pending a charge being
preferred against him.

A. L. Labrum
Det. Inspector

REPORTED ARREST OF C.D.S.219 BY OTHER AUTHORITIES.
====================================================

Further to attached reports; continued enquiries
have not been successful in bringing to light the
whereabouts of the missing C.D.S. Representatives of
organizations in the Western Area known to detectives
attached to B'Well Station have been approached and given
full particulars and photographs of C.D.S.219 Yao Chang
Ming and all have promised to co-operate to the fullest
extent in endeavouring to locate him.

On the morning of 22-6-40, Yao Li Sz, the legal wife
of Yao Chang Ming, reported to the undersigned that she
had received information that her husband was being
detained at 22 Sing Ny Tsung, Singapore Road.

D.I. Tabrum and D.S.Nagamine accompanied her to
94 Jessfield Road, J.M.P. Headquarters, where the
information was communicated to Warrant Officer Shida who
promptly detailed a party of his subordinates to search
the premises in question. Taking with them photographs
of the C.D.S. the party left and returned about 30 minutes
later to report that the only persons found in the house
were one male and four female Chinese and no information
regarding the missing C.D.S. could be elicited.

During the raiding party's absence, W.O. Shida
stated in order to discount rumours circulating to the
effect that the C.D.S. was being detained in the cells

据报C.D.S.219号被其他当局逮捕。
====================================================

继附呈报告之后；持续的调查未能查明失踪刑事侦缉警员的下落。静安寺警局所属侦探所熟知的西区各组织代表已与其接触，并提供了C.D.S.219号姚昌明（Yao Chang Ming）的详细资料和照片，所有代表均承诺在尽力寻找其下落方面给予最充分的合作。

1940年6月22日上午，姚昌明的合法妻子姚李氏（Yao Li Sz）向卑职报告称，她收到消息说她的丈夫被拘禁在新加坡路信义邨22号。

塔布鲁姆探长和永峰（Nagamine）侦探陪同她前往极司菲尔路94号日本宪兵队总部，将该消息传达给志田（Shida）准尉，后者立即指派一队下属搜查上述处所。搜查队携带了该刑事侦缉警员的照片离开，约30分钟后返回报告称，屋内只发现一名中国男子和四名中国女子，无法获取有关失踪刑事侦缉警员的任何信息。

在搜查队外出期间，志田准尉表示，为了消除流传的关于该刑事侦缉警员被关押在牢房中的谣言

（批：档案 24/6）

REPORTED ARREST OF C.D.S.219 BY OTHER AUTHORITIES.
Further to report dated June 16, 1940 Yao Tung Sz,
concubine of C.D.S.219 Yao Chang Ming, was called to
this office at 9 a.m. 18-6-40, and when questioned by
D.I. Tabrum and D.S.I. Yao Yuen Loong, stated:-
To effect the release of Yao Chang Ming, whom she
understood was being held at 94 Jessfield Road by the
Japanese Military Police, she had approached one Lieu
Tuh Ching (刘德清), father of Lieu Nan Yin (刘兰英) and
a follower of Chu Zung Ling (朱顺林) who was employed
as the chief of the armed guards at the Hollywood
Gambling Den. Through him she obtained an interview
with Ting Chien Kwang (丁建光), Captain of the Special
Service Corps, at 12 Sing Nyi Tsung (信义) off
Jessfield Road. The latter informed her that the C.D.S.
had been arrested by members of the Special Service
Corps and had been handed over to the Japanese Military
Police, 94 Jessfield Road, on suspicion that he was
investigating into the activities of the organization
and passing such information he gleaned to the S.M.P.
Ting assured Yao Tung Sz that the C.D.S. had not
been ill-treated and that he would intercede on her
behalf with a view to effecting the early release of
the detective.

D.D.C. "B" Div. R. E. Tabrum
Det. Inspector.

据报C.D.S.219号被其他当局逮捕。
继1940年6月16日的报告之后，C.D.S.219号姚昌明的妾室姚佟氏（Yao Tung Sz）于1940年6月18日上午9时被传唤至本办公室，并在接受塔布鲁姆探长和姚元龙（Yao Yuen Loong）副探长讯问时陈述如下：
为了释放她理解中被日本宪兵队关押在极司菲尔路94号的姚昌明，她求助于刘德清（Lieu Tuh Ching），即刘兰英（Lieu Nan Yin）的父亲，也是朱顺林（Chu Zung Ling）的追随者，朱顺林受雇为好莱坞赌场武装警卫头目。通过他，她在极司菲尔路旁的信义邨12号得以面见特别服务队队长丁建光（Ting Chien Kwang）。后者告知她，该刑事侦缉警员已被特别服务队成员逮捕，并因涉嫌调查该组织的活动并将搜集到的情报传递给上海公共租界工部局警务处，而被移交给极司菲尔路94号的日本宪兵队。丁向姚佟氏保证，该刑事侦缉警员未受虐待，并将代表她进行斡旋，以期尽早释放该侦探。

REPORTED ARREST OF C.D.S.219 BY OTHER AUTHORITIES.
--------------------------------------------------
    Further to report dated June 15, 1940 concerning
the reported arrest of C.D.S.219, I have to report that
so far efforts to locate the whereabouts of the
detective have not proved successful.
    On the morning of 16-6-40, permission was obtained
from Mr. Clissold, D.D.C. "B" Division, for detectives
to make enquiries at No.76. D.I. Tabrum, D.S.I.s Young
and Yao Yuen Loong visited this establishment and there
interviewed Captain Woo S Pao (吳書寶) who stated that
he had no knowledge of the missing detective and added
that he was convinced that his organization was in no
way connected with the incident. He promised to make
all enquiries and communicate with Bubbling Well Police
Station should he learn anything of value.
    A visit was then paid to Japanese Military Police
Headquarters at 94 Jessfield Road in company with D.S.
Nagamune. There Warrant Officer Shida was interviewed
and stated he had no knowledge of the arrest of the
detective. He promised to have full enquiries made with
particular reference to addresses given to him by D.I.
Tabrum and asked that a photograph of the missing man
be given to him.

据报C.D.S.219号被其他当局逮捕。
--------------------------------------------------
    继1940年6月15日关于据报逮捕C.D.S.219号的报告之后，谨此报告，迄今为止，寻找该侦探下落的努力尚未成功。
    1940年6月16日上午，经"B"分区副主管克利索尔德（Clissold）先生批准，侦探们前往76号进行调查。塔布鲁姆探长、杨（Young）副探长和姚元龙副探长访问了该机构，并在那里会见了吴书宝（Woo S Pao）队长，后者表示他对失踪侦探一无所知，并补充说他确信他的组织与此事件毫无关联。他承诺将进行所有查询，如果得知任何有价值的信息，将与静安寺警察局联系。
    随后，与永宗（Nagamune）侦探一同访问了位于极司菲尔路94号的日本宪兵队总部。在那里会见了志田（Shida）准尉，他表示不知道逮捕该侦探一事。他承诺进行全面查询，特别关注塔布鲁姆探长提供给他的地址，并要求提供失踪者的照片。

The warrant card of the missing detective
which was found in his office drawer together with his
pistol and ammunition was therefore taken to Warrant
Officer Hida by P.C. Hayamuno.

At 10.1 a.m. 16-6-40 P.C.32 brought to the
Station the girl who had informed Yao Tung Sz of the
incident. The girl gave her particulars as Lieu Nan
Yin (刘简英); aged 15, native of Anhwei, residing 99
Ting Fong Li (忻家里), Jessfield road, S.C.G.P.B.. She
was located and handed over to P.C.32 by Yao Tung Sz.

At the Station she was questioned and gave
substantially the same account of the affair as that
contained in Diary No.1, save that she states the
Japanese was wearing green uniform(See statement attached).

Yao Tung Sz again came to the Station and on being
further questioned stated that after receiving the
report of Lieu Nan Yin, and before coming to the
Station, she had gone to see some friends of the missing
detective at Jessfield Village.

These friends are employed by Japanese and they
told her that S.D.S.219 was being detained at 94
Jessfield road. They gave her the address of 94 and
also a paper giving a vague description of those
responsible for his abduction(Paper with translation
attached).

失踪侦探的委任证在其办公室抽屉中与他的手枪和弹药一起被发现，因此由滨野（Hayamuno）警员交给了日田（Hida）准尉。

1940年6月16日上午10:10，32号警员将向姚佟氏通报此事的女孩带到警局。该女孩提供的个人资料为刘简英（Lieu Nan Yin）；15岁，安徽籍，居住于四川越界筑路区极司菲尔路忻家里99号。她由姚佟氏找到并移交给32号警员。

在警局，她接受了讯问，其陈述的内容与日记第1号中的记载基本相同，只是她说那名日本人穿着绿色制服（见附件陈述）。

姚佟氏再次来到警局，在接受进一步讯问时陈述，在收到刘简英的报告后，以及在来警局之前，她曾去极司菲尔村看望失踪侦探的一些朋友。

这些朋友受雇于日本人，他们告诉她，S.D.S.219号正被拘禁在极司菲尔路94号。他们给了她94号的地址，还给她一张纸，上面模糊地描述了负责绑架他的人（附有翻译的纸张）。

Warrant officer hide having expressed the wish
to question the girl who had given the information to
Yao Tung z, she was taken to 94 Jessfield Road by
D.C. Nagamure at 11 a.m. 16-6-40 and was returned to
Bubbling Well Station at 11.45 a.m.
At 9 a.m. 16-6-40 a Chinese female Yao Li Iz
(姚李氏) came to the Station and stated she was the
proper wife of Yao Chang ing. It then came to light
that the woman who had reported the case on 15-6-40
is the concubine of C.D..219 and resides at 596
Connaught Road, whilst the legal wife resides at Lane
176, House No.1, Chungking Road. This probably
accounts for the presence of the detective in the
vicinity of Connaught - Jessfield Roads Bus Stop at
the time of his abduction.

A. E. Robinson
Det. Inspector

日田（hide/hida）准尉表示希望讯问向姚佟氏（Yao Tung z）提供信息的女孩，因此永村（Nagamure）侦探于1940年6月16日上午11时将女孩带至极司菲尔路94号，并于上午11:45将她送回静安寺警局。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Liu Lai Ying, age 13, (99 Sing Kong Li, Jessfield)
native of Anhwei ........................................ taken by me D.I. Tong
at B'Well .................... on the 16-6-40. ........ translated by Clerk C.F. Woo
.................................................... and interpreted by ....................

At about 11 a.m. 15-6-40, whilst walking back
to home from Brenan Piece Market and when I arrived at
th corner of Jessfield Rd and Connaught Rd I saw one
Japanese in yellow uniform and 3 Chinese in foreign dress.
They were arresting Yao Chang Ming who was waiting for a
No. 10 Route Bus at the station. I recognize Yao because
he is my father's friend and often comes to my father's
factory. When the 3 mentioned Chinese arrested Yao, he
was asked by them whether he was Yao Chang Ming. Yao
answered that he was. He was then hand cuffed and taken
away. As I was rather upset I dared not remain there any
longer. I went back to my home and told my father what
I had seen. My father then wrote a chit and asked me to
take the same to the Sung Sung Li, Connaught Rd, (396
Connaught Road) the upstairs of the Yung Loh Yee Barber
Shop where Yao lives. When I arrived there no one was
on the premises. I went there again at 5p.m. I then met
Yao's wife who I then informed. She gave me 40cts. for
car fare to go back to my home.

At 10.15 a.m. 16-6-40, I made this statement
in B'Well Police Station.

This is my true statement.

以下是刘来英（Liu Lai Ying），13岁，（极司菲尔路新康里99号）
安徽籍 ........................................ 由我，童（Tong）探长
在静安寺 .................... 于1940年6月16日 ........ 录取。由职员吴CF（C.F. Woo）翻译
.................................................... 并由 .................... 口译

1940年6月15日上午11点左右，当我从布伦南片市场（Brenan Piece Market）走回家，到达极司菲尔路和康纳脱路的拐角时，我看到一名穿黄色制服的日本人和三名穿西装的中国人。他们正在逮捕姚昌明，当时他正在车站等候10路公交车。我认出姚是因为他是我父亲的朋友，经常来我父亲的工厂。当上述三名中国人逮捕姚时，他们问他是否是姚昌明。姚回答说是。随后他被戴上手铐并被带走。因为我很害怕，不敢再在那里逗留。我回到家，把看到的情况告诉了我父亲。我父亲写了一张纸条，让我把它送到康纳脱路松松里（Sung Sung Li），即姚居住的永乐理发店楼上（康纳脱路396号）。当我到达那里时，屋里没有人。下午5点我又去了一次。那时我遇到了姚的妻子，我便通知了她。她给了我40分车费让我回家。

1940年6月16日上午10:15，我在静安寺警察局作了此陈述。

这是我的真实陈述。

1.

REPORTED ARREST OF C.D.S. 219 BY OTHER AUTHORITIES

At 7.30p.m. 15/6/40, Yao Tung Sz (姚氏), wife
of C.D.S. 219, Yao Chang Ming (姚昌敏), came to the
station and reported C.D.S. 219 had left his home at
588, Connaught Road, at 8a.m. 15/6/40 to come to the
station and had failed to return.

At about 5.30p.m. 15/6/40 a Chinese girl, aged
about 11 years and a native of the same country as the
wife of C.D.S. 219, came to her home and informed her
that whilst she was playing on Connaught Road near
Jessfield Road at about 10a.m. 15/6/40 she saw three
male Chinese and one male Japanese, one of the former
being armed with a Mauser pistol, arrest a male
Chinese, who was walking on Connaught Road in the
direction of a No. 11 route bus station. The party
walked away south along Jessfield Road after handcuff-
ing their prisoner with metal handcuffs. The girl
stated that she recognized the arrested man as Yao
Chang Ming.

The girl added that she returned to her home
after witnessing the incident and informed her parents
who instructed her to inform Yao Chang Ming's wife.
According to her story she came to do so at 11a.m.
15/6/40, but Mrs. Yao was not at home.

（批：Rel 14/6）

据报C.D.S. 219号被其他当局逮捕

1940年6月15日下午7:30，C.D.S. 219号姚昌明（Yao Chang Ming）的妻子姚氏（Yao Tung Sz）来到警局，报告称C.D.S. 219号于1940年6月15日上午8时离开康纳脱路588号的住所前来警局，但至今未归。

1940年6月15日下午5:30左右，一名约11岁的中国女孩来到她家，该女孩与C.D.S. 219号的妻子是同乡。女孩告知她，1940年6月15日上午10点左右，当她在康纳脱路靠近极司菲尔路的地方玩耍时，看到三名中国男子和一名日本男子，其中一名中国人持有毛瑟手枪，逮捕了一名正沿着康纳脱路朝11路公交车站方向行走的中国男子。这群人给囚犯戴上金属手铐后，沿着极司菲尔路向南走去。女孩称她认出被捕者是姚昌明。

女孩补充说，她在目睹此事后回到家中，告诉了父母，父母指示她去通知姚昌明的妻子。据她说，她于1940年6月15日上午11时前去通知，但姚太太不在家。

（批：Rel 14/6）

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SP. BR. REGISTRY

Miss.No. 414/40.

1/2.

Informant states she has never previously seen the
girl and did not obtain any information regarding her,
or in what way she came to know C.D.S. 219, when she
called, but allowed her to go after giving her a few
cents.

On receipt of the information informant took no
action until she came to the station to report the
matter.

Following the report, Inspr. Smith, D.S.I. Young
and D.S. Nagamune visited Japanese Gendarmerie Head-
quarters at 94 Jessfield Road and made enquiries
regarding the missing officer; but they were unable
to give any information.

Inspr. Smith, D.S.I.s Young and Yao Yeen Leong
then visited S.C.C.P.B. Headquarters at 13 Jessfield
Road, but were again unable to obtain any information.

It has been learned from other Chinese detectives
attached to the station that C.D.S. 219 came to the
station at about 9.30a.m. 15/6/40 and left at about
10a.m.

Enquiries with a view to locating the girl who
informed Mrs. Yao are being prosecuted.

Teleprinter message asking for Bubbling Well
Station to be informed should C.D.S. 219 be seen

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处

案件编号：414/40。

1/2.

线人称，她此前从未见过该女孩，也未获得关于她的任何信息；当该女孩前来时，线人并不知晓她是怎样认识华籍警探第219号（C.D.S. 219）的，但在给了她几分钱后便让她离开。

收到该消息后，线人未采取任何行动，直至其来到巡捕房报告此事。

接到报告后，史密斯督察（Inspr. Smith）、杨副督察（D.S.I. Young）和永井巡佐（D.S. Nagamune）前往杰斯菲尔德路94号的日本宪兵队总部，就那名失踪警官一事进行查询；但对方未能提供任何信息。

随后，史密斯督察、杨副督察和姚仁龙副督察（D.S.I. Yao Yeen Leong）前往杰斯菲尔德路13号的上海市警察局（S.C.C.P.B.）总部，但再次未能获得任何信息。

从配属该巡捕房的其他华籍侦探处获悉，华籍警探第219号于1940年6月15日上午9时30分左右到达巡捕房，并于上午10时左右离开。

为寻找曾向姚太太提供消息的那名女孩而进行的查询工作正在开展中。

已发出电传打字机消息，要求若发现华籍警探第219号，即通知静安寺巡捕房（Bubbling Well Station）。
